_: Packs that are finished but deliberately not yet wired into prose.js.
verify.py hard-fails on a pack nobody imports, because that is normally a
translation nobody can read. These two are the exception: they are large
enough that a static import would put them in the English bundle, and the
fix is the lazy chunk prose.js's own header describes -- not an import.
An entry here turns that failure into a warning that names the reason, so
the work is visible every single run instead of being quietly forgotten.
Delete an entry the moment its pack is reachable.

spells.reason: 4062 strings. Needs the lazy chunk prose.js describes, not a static import -- an English reader must not download it.

monsters.reason: 906 strings, and the English monsters.json is already a lazy chunk in loadFile.js -- a static pack would pull the Italian into the main bundle that the English was deliberately kept out of.
